body: Stance detection remains challenging for large language models (LLMs) due to implicit opinions, sarcasm, and context-dependent expressions of stance. Although automatic prompt optimization offers an alternative to fine-tuning without updating model parameters, existing structured approaches are not specifically designed around stance-label semantics and class-specific ambiguities. We introduce MoPrO-SD, a stance-specific prompt optimization framework that decomposes prompts into functional semantic modules and refines them sequentially using LLM-based feedback. We study three refinement strategies: instruction-only optimization (I), instruction with reasoning (I+R), and instruction with per-example reasoning (I+R+E), using class-conditioned errors for stance-label refinement. We also introduce VaccineStance, a new human-annotated benchmark for vaccine stance detection. Experiments across four datasets and five open-weight LLMs show that MoPrO-SD improves upon the human-written Base prompt in many settings. On SemEval-2016, class-conditioned feedback achieves higher mean Macro-F1 than pooled feedback for four of five backbones. Both reasoning-based strategies, I+R and I+R+E, achieve strong performance, with their relative effectiveness varying across models and datasets, while remaining competitive with recent prompt optimization methods. The MoPrO-SD code and VaccineStance dataset are available on GitHub.
summaryZh: MoPrO-SD 是一种针对立场检测任务的模块化提示优化框架，通过将提示词分解为功能性语义模块，并利用基于 LLM 的反馈进行序列化优化。该研究引入了三种优化策略，特别是基于类条件错误的反馈机制，在多个数据集上显著优于传统的人工编写提示。此外，研究还发布了 VaccineStance 数据集，为疫苗立场检测提供了新的基准，证明了该方法在处理隐含观点和讽刺等复杂语义时的有效性。

glossary.explanationZh: 立场检测，旨在识别文本中作者对特定主题的态度或立场。
提示优化，通过自动调整提示词以提升模型在特定任务上的表现。
一种分类评估指标，计算各类别F1分数的算术平均值。
类条件反馈，根据特定类别的错误表现进行针对性的提示词修正。
